label: Ages of deaths by cause (shared, for valuing deaths by age)

rows.label: Share of ambient air-pollution deaths under age 5 (GBD 2023, world)

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2023 (risk-attributable deaths by age), via Our World in Data
source.note: World, 2023: deaths from all causes attributed to ambient particulate matter pollution, by age: under 5 171,352; 5–14 7,808; 15–49 228,278; 50–69 1,277,577; 70+ 3,234,154 (total 4.92 million). OWID indicators 1171329, 1171319, 1171315, 1171320, 1171325.

rows.explainer: How the deaths that fossil-fuel and other fine-particle air pollution causes are spread over ages (GBD 2023, world). The site values a death by the age it happens at (GiveWell's moral weights by age, @moral_weights), so climate's air-pollution deaths and Ambitious Impact's air-pollution models are valued with this mix rather than GiveWell's all-ages value for malaria deaths over five (73.19). GiveWell publishes no band above 74, so 50 and over is valued at its 50–74 weight.

rows.label: Share of heat deaths under age 5 (GBD 2023, world)

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2023 (risk-attributable deaths by age), via Our World in Data
source.note: World, 2023: deaths from all causes attributed to high temperature, by age: under 5 38,942; 5–14 11,990; 15–49 89,652; 50–69 153,940; 70+ 244,723 (total 539,247). OWID indicators 1171698, 1171689, 1171686, 1171692, 1171695, 1171701 (gbd_risk_deaths).

rows.explainer: How today's heat deaths are spread over ages (GBD 2023, world), used as the age mix of the heat deaths a tonne of CO₂ causes. Our judgment that today's mix stands in for the deaths that come late this century: populations will be older then, so if anything it values heat deaths a little high. 50 and over is valued at GiveWell's 50–74 weight (no older band is published).

rows.label: Deaths per DALY attributed to ambient particulate matter pollution (GBD 2023, India)

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2023 (risk-attributable deaths by age), via Our World in Data
source.note: India, 2023: 969,726 deaths (sum of the age bands, OWID indicators 1171315–1171329) and 27,071,802 DALYs (OWID indicator 1188393) attributed to ambient particulate matter pollution.

rows.explainer: Turns the GBD DALYs an Ambitious Impact air-pollution model counts (Neev's kiln smoke in northern India) back into the deaths behind them, so each death can be valued by age like every other death on the site: 27.9 DALYs per death.

rows.label: Share of ambient air-pollution DALYs that are years lived with disability (not deaths)

source.title: Burden of disease in Germany attributed to ambient particulate matter pollution: GBD 2019 (and GBD 2019 for Libya)
source.note: Germany 24% of ambient-PM DALYs are YLDs, Libya 17% (GBD 2019). Countries with younger deaths have more years of life lost per death, so a smaller YLD share: our judgment for India and the world 8%, range 5% to Germany's 24%.

rows.explainer: The part of an air-pollution DALY that is illness rather than death. It stays a DALY when Ambitious Impact's DALYs are split into deaths (valued by age) and the rest.

rows.label: Share of smoking deaths at ages 15 to 49 (GBD 2023, Mongolia)

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2023 (risk-attributable deaths by age), via Our World in Data
source.note: Mongolia, 2023: deaths from all causes attributed to smoking: 15–49 441; 50–69 1,388; 70+ 440 (total 2,269); DALYs 82,747. OWID indicators 1172062, 1172064, 1172070, 1172074, 1188411.

rows.explainer: Smoking deaths in Mongolia by age (GBD 2023), for Ambitious Impact's tobacco-tax model (Concentric Policies): its DALYs are split back into deaths and each death valued by age. No smoking deaths fall under 15.

rows.label: Deaths per DALY attributed to smoking (GBD 2023, Mongolia)

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2023 (risk-attributable deaths by age), via Our World in Data
source.note: Mongolia, 2023: deaths from all causes attributed to smoking: 15–49 441; 50–69 1,388; 70+ 440 (total 2,269); DALYs 82,747. OWID indicators 1172062, 1172064, 1172070, 1172074, 1188411.

rows.explainer: 36.5 DALYs per smoking death in Mongolia.

rows.label: Share of smoking DALYs that are years lived with disability (not deaths)
rows.explainer: Our judgment: most of smoking's burden is early death (heart disease, stroke, cancers); the illness part is mostly chronic lung disease. 10%, from 5% to 20%. It stays a DALY when the deaths are valued by age.

rows.label: Deaths per DALY attributable to bacterial antimicrobial resistance (GRAM, 2021)

source.title: GBD 2021 Antimicrobial Resistance Collaborators, Global burden of bacterial antimicrobial resistance 1990–2021 (Lancet 2024)
source.quote: The global number of DALYs attributable to AMR decreased between 1990 (60·9 million [95% UI 47·7–74·1]) and 2021 (42·6 million [36·1–49·0])
source.note: 1.14 million deaths attributable to AMR in 2021 over 42.6 million attributable DALYs: 37.4 DALYs per death.

rows.explainer: Turns the AMR DALYs in Ambitious Impact's antibiotics model (ARMoR) back into deaths, so each can be valued by age.

rows.label: Share of AMR-attributable deaths under age 5 (GRAM 2021)

source.title: GBD 2021 Antimicrobial Resistance Collaborators, Global burden of bacterial antimicrobial resistance 1990–2021 (Lancet 2024)
source.quote: For children younger than 5 years in 2021, there were 193 000 deaths (144 000–242 000) attributable to AMR globally
source.note: Under 5: 193,000 of 1.14 million attributable deaths (17%). The paper gives no world split above five; 70 and over make up 65.9% of attributable deaths in its 2050 forecast and 83.9% in high-income Asia Pacific in 2021. The split of the 83% at five and older is our judgment: 2% at 5–14, 14% at 15–49, 67% at 50 and older.

rows.explainer: Ages of the deaths antimicrobial resistance causes, for ARMoR's model: under five from GRAM 2021; the split above five is our judgment from GRAM's regional and 2050 shares (the policy's benefits come years from now, when more of these deaths are of older people).
